name: zcode-swarm
description: Team development for ZCode (v2.0): the main session orchestrates directly via the Agent tool — one requirement splits into task cards, background builders run in parallel with per-card independent review, rework, dynamic expansion and gate verification; state lives in .swarm/ledger.json, progress on Gen UI cards and a persistent side-panel team board (swarm_board). Models are decided by ZCode Settings → Subagents (ZCode Swarm); the plugin does not configure models. No workflow-engine launch step: send /swarm <requirement>.

Models are decided by ZCode Settings → Subagents (ZCode Swarm); the plugin does not configure models. No workflow-engine launch step: send /swarm <requirement>.
description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 团队开发（v2.0）：主会话直接编排 —— 需求拆成任务卡，后台施工员并行施工、逐卡独立审查、按意见返工、动态扩编、整体验证；状态记在 .swarm/ledger.json，进度看 Gen UI 卡片与常驻侧栏团队看板（swarm_board）。模型由 ZCode 设置 → 子智能体 → ZCode Swarm 决定，插件不再配置模型。发 /swarm <需求> 即开工。

reworkRounds.title: Rework rounds
reworkRounds.description: 审查 FAIL 后最多返工轮数，0-5（0 = 不返工，直接交人）。仅当项目没有专属名单时生效；脚本只读不改。
